credits.title: Love Test
credits.overview: A woman stages her own disappearance to test her boyfriend's love, only for him to quickly start a passionate relationship with another woman who unknowingly becomes entangled in the original scheme.

credits.title: Some Like It Hot
credits.overview: After the unexpected death of his best friend, a man examines his life and finds it incredibly lonely.  Inspired by an encounter with a beautiful and sexy model, he embarks with his three friends on what turns out to be a crazy (and slightly stupid) endeavor on a path towards fulfillment.

credits.title: Xuan Zang
credits.overview: Chinese-Indian historical adventure of Xuan Zang's seventeen-year overland journey to India during the Tang dynasty in the seventh century.

credits.title: If You Are the One
credits.overview: Qin Fen, a funny, honest, single inventor, met a girl called Smiley, who was in agony of her boyfriend's betrayal. They traveled to Hokkaido, tried to help Smiley cure her pain in heart, and both of them gradually found their true love and life redemption during the journey.
